kinds.L: Liquid or instant-unstake. Lock inner token/receipt, instant redeem same thing. HyperEVM ticker hPREFIX. Job is to introduce the asset.
kinds.C1: Long lock / no transferable receipt. Inbound only. Exit is the HyperEVM market. Ticker encodes lock.
kinds.C2: Unstake exists with a known wait. Burn hToken, wait redeemDelay, claim inner on source.

listings.name: Hyperleaf QUID
listings.note: Squid $QUID. Stake has no lock (unstake anytime). No need to wrap their stake position. Lock QUID, mint hQUID, redeem QUID. Same job as Unit: put the asset on HyperEVM.

listings.name: Hyperliquid VIRTUAL 4Year
listings.note: veVIRTUAL is not a liquid 1:1 ERC20. C1 closed ticker so the book is not confused with Unit VIRTUAL. Official UI max lock is often 2y; ticker follows the 4y product you want. Do not turn this into C2 later.

listings.name: Hyperliquid BLUAI 4Year
listings.disclaimer: Closed-end. No protocol redeem. Price can trade below NAV.

listings.name: Hyperliquid BONK 12Month
listings.note: Bonk Rewards 12-month lock. No early withdraw. Needs Solana lockbox. Do not wrap BONKsol (that is a SOL LST).

listings.name: Hyperleaf MET
listings.note: Meteora MET. Unstake is allowed, ~21 day unbonding. C2: burn hMET, wait, claim MET on Solana. Yield is USDC/fees on Meteora, not on the hToken.
